subject_lessons.title: Y1 Math: Counting to 100, Addition & 2D Shapes
subject_lessons.story:
TRADITIONAL MATH LESSON (GRADE 1):
Numbers help us count everything around us! When we put two groups together, we use Addition (+). When we take away, we use Subtraction (-). We also compare numbers using Greater Than (>) and Less Than (<).

• Example: If Lumi's rocket has 100 fuel units and we add 60 more, 100 + 60 = 160 fuel units!
• Geometric Shapes: The landing pad is a flat rectangle, and the Moon is a round circle (sphere).

subject_lessons.title: Y1 Science: Day & Night, Moon Phases & Push/Pull Forces
subject_lessons.story:
TRADITIONAL SCIENCE LESSON (GRADE 1):
Every object in the universe feels Pushes and Pulls called Forces!
• Gravity is an invisible PULL force that pulls objects down toward the ground.
• A Rocket Thruster is a PUSH force that pushes the rocket upward into the sky.
• The Moon is smaller than Earth, so the Moon's gravity pull (1.62) is much gentler than Earth's (9.8)!

subject_lessons.story:
TRADITIONAL READING & LANGUAGE ARTS LESSON (GRADE 1):
Read this short story out loud:
  "Lumi is a little silver robot. Lumi looks for the bright gold star in the maze. Lumi steps over the hot red lava and wins a shiny trophy!"

• Reading Check:
  1. Who is the main character? -> Lumi the robot.
  2. What is the setting (where does it happen)? -> Inside the maze.
  3. Sight Words to practice: look, bright, over, little, find.

subject_lessons.title: Y1 Social Studies: My Community & Compass Directions (N, S, E, W)
subject_lessons.story:
TRADITIONAL SOCIAL STUDIES & GEOGRAPHY LESSON (GRADE 1):
Maps help people in our community find schools, parks, libraries, and homes!
Every map has a Compass Rose with 4 Cardinal Directions:
  • North (Up ↑)
  • East  (Right →)
  • South (Down ↓)
  • West  (Left ←)
In our Maze Map, Lumi starts in the West (left) and travels East (right) around the lava to reach the Treasure!
